problem: Native Excel specimens exposed rejection of hyperlink revision GUIDs and zero DPI markers, plus unnecessary content-type canonicalization during calculation-chain invalidation. Encrypted XLSB reached a generic ZIP error instead of an explicit unsupported container boundary.
changes: Retain the exact xr:uid GUID in the inert hyperlink model, reader and writer; account for its retained bytes. Namespace aliases and Strict/Transitional owners work, including a main-namespace xr prefix. Foreign/unqualified/duplicate identity attributes and malformed GUIDs remain errors.
Retain native macOS Excel horizontalDpi/verticalDpi zero markers as Dpi::UNSPECIFIED. The positive authored Dpi::new contract remains unchanged; negative and overflowing wire values still fail.

Calculation-chain removal uses a source-bound content-types transition, preserving unrelated defaults and overrides instead of rebuilding them as different mappings. Existing recalculation flags and chain removal remain explicit expected edit effects.

Classify OPC ZIP failures on CFB-signature input as a typed XLSB UnsupportedFeature across owning, eager, sequential-lazy and positional-lazy ingress. Input limits and execution/source errors keep precedence; the positional diagnostic read is source-fenced. No decryption capability is added.

Add native XLSX catalog, formula/cache, validation/note/name/print, date/visibility/page-break, hyperlink-edit, scalar-CRUD and Agile rekey tests, plus native XLS CryptoAPI and XLSB unsupported-encryption tests and an operations query/atomic-edit regression.

Correct two existing minimal-feature operations tests: disabled Keynote plan compilation expects UnsupportedCapability; rich-note runs are compared as JSON fields rather than object serialization order.

verification_scope.catalogs: 18 unencrypted XLSX/XLSM/XLTX/XLTM files, including Strict, chartsheets and an XLM macro sheet, have exact names/order/kinds/flavors and full no-op member-payload preservation.
verification_scope.formulas: CSE anchor/range/cache and followers; all 100 copied/shared ROW()*2 cells; stored SEQUENCE/FILTER/LET expressions and spill values; two what-if data-table owner ranges/caches. Cache origin/freshness is explicitly Stored/Unknown; nothing is evaluated.
verification_scope.interaction: Seven validation kinds/ranges/bounds and UIDs, two exact note bodies with author prefixes and CRLF, three defined names, landscape/scale/first-page and selected margins, native zero DPI markers, and cached totals.
verification_scope.dates: 1904 date system and exact serial lexemes, including negative and time-only values; hidden rows 14/15 and column J; manual page-break IDs and perpendicular bounds.
verification_scope.edits: Scalar create/update/remove on 17 unprotected native variants; the protected eighteenth fixture has an exact ProtectedSheet refusal and unchanged source. Chain removal, content-type/relationship removal entries and five recalculation fields are checked as related changes. All other part bytes and unrelated workbook/manifest fields are preserved.
verification_scope.inverse: Retained-owner inverses restore all original member bytes. After save/reopen, content types and other payloads remain byte exact; workbook relationship entry order may canonicalize, so every root/relationship field is compared independently of order.
verification_scope.xlsx_encryption: Native Agile AES-256/CBC/SHA-512; empty/wrong/correct public fixture passwords, 42/84 scalar/cache, implicit plaintext refusal, rekey with old-password rejection and unchanged clear member payloads. Decryption remains in memory.
verification_scope.xls_encryption: Native BIFF CryptoAPI RC4 128-bit; absent/wrong/correct passwords, exact marker and 42/84 cells, implicit-publication refusal and exact ciphertext retention. No rekey or clear serialization is claimed.
verification_scope.xlsb_encryption: No password API/decryption support. The native CFB artifact has an explicit UnsupportedFeature result after ordinary admission; this identifies the container signature, not cryptographic validity or password correctness.
verification_scope.operations: Auto/Eager routes query stored value 206 at Sheet1 D103, read ROW()*2, atomically create a number and formula-looking inert text on two sheets, reopen and invert exactly.
verification_scope.corpus_environment: Materialized the already tracked docs/report/spec-gap-validation-evidence/xlsx-form-control-properties/native-corpus.json needed by existing form-control tests. No native fixture bytes were modified.
